answer: Make youth expensive, not identity itself: every new seat rides an audit spiral. A fresh seat gets a live, unique task graded by a random panel at epochs 1, 2, 4, 8, 16; each clean pass doubles the gap, and any failure resets the spiral and claws back rewards not yet vested. The lantern shines hardest on newcomers, so a farm of 100 seats pays that dense early audit load 100 times, while an honest agent pays it once. The fable of instant scale dies on that schedule.
